service.method: SELECT Q.QNA_NUMBER , Q.COMPANY_CODE , Q.SUBJECT , Q.ATTACH_NO , Q.KEYWORDS , Q.CONTENT , Q.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = Q.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME , Q.ADD_DATE , NVL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SQNAR WHERE HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND QNA_NUMBER = Q.QNA_NUMBER AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'), 0) AS REPLY_CNT , Q.QNA_COMPANY , Q.QNA_TYPE , GETDEPTNAME('012', Q.QNA_COMPANY, Q.QNA_USER_DEPT_CODE, 'KO') AS QNA_DEPT_NAME , Q.STATUS , Q.CHECK_FLAG , Q.MANAGER AS MANAGER_ID , GETUSERNAME(Q.HOUSE_CODE, Q.COMPANY_CODE, Q.MANAGER, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS MANAGER FROM SQNAQ Q WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND NVL(Q.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT R.QNA_NUMBER , R.QNA_SEQ , R.ATTACH_NO , R.CONTENT , R.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = R.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = R.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME , R.ADD_DATE , R.ADD_TIME , DEL_FLAG , R.QNA_COMPANY FROM SQNAR R WHERE R.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND R.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND NVL(R.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY CAST(R.QNA_SEQ AS INT)

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , QNA_NUMBER , ADD_USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME FROM SQNAQ WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER}
SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , DEPT , DEPT_NAME_LOC , PARENT_DEPT FROM SDEPT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE}

SELECT Q.* , NVL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SQNAR WHERE HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND QNA_NUMBER = Q.QNA_NUMBER AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'), 0 ) AS REPLY_CNT
FROM ( SELECT Q.HOUSE_CODE , Q.COMPANY_CODE , Q.QNA_NUMBER , Q.SUBJECT , Q.ATTACH_NO , Q.KEYWORDS , Q.CONTENT , Q.ADD_USER_ID , U.USER_NAME_LOC AS ADD_USER_NAME , Q.ADD_DATE , Q.DEL_FLAG , Q.QNA_COMPANY , Q.ROW_NUM , #DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME('#session.HOUSE_CODE#', Q.QNA_COMPANY, Q.QNA_USER_DEPT_CODE, '#session.LANGUAGE#') AS QNA_DEPT_NAME , Q.QNA_TYPE , Q.CHECK_FLAG , Q.STATUS , Q.QNA_USER_DEPT_CODE , GETUSERNAME(Q.HOUSE_CODE, Q.COMPANY_CODE, Q.MANAGER, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as MANAGER , MANAGER AS MANAGER_ID , CASE WHEN Q.STATUS IN ('F','A','G','CC') THEN Q.CHANGE_DATE ELSE '' END AS GW_CONFIRM_DATE FROM SQNAQ Q LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT U ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = U.HOUSE_CODE AND Q.ADD_USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(Q.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND Q.QNA_SYSTEM = $S{session.SYSTEM_TYPE}
AND Q.QNA_NUMBER LIKE 'CQNA%'
AND Q.QNA_NUMBER LIKE 'LQNA%'
AND Q.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_WRITE_DATE_FROM} AND Q.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_WRITE_DATE_TO} AND Q.STATUS = $S{F_STATUS} AND Q.QNA_USER_DEPT_CODE = ($INS{F_DEPT}) AND UPPER(Q.KEYWORDS) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' AND ( UPPER(Q.KEYWORDS) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(Q.SUBJECT) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(U.USER_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) ) Q WHERE ( UPPER(Q.QNA_COMPANY) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_USER_COMPANY}) || '%' OR UPPER(Q.QNA_COMPANY_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_USER_COMPANY}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) AND ( UPPER(Q.ADD_USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_ADD_USER}) || '%' OR UPPER(Q.ADD_USER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_ADD_USER}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) AND ( 1=1 AND UPPER(Q.MANAGER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_MANAGER}) || '%' OR UPPER(Q.MANAGER) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_MANAGER}) || '%' ) ORDER BY Q.QNA_NUMBER DESC

SELECT Q.ROW_NUM , Q.QNA_NUMBER , NVL( ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SQNAR R WHERE R.HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND R.QNA_NUMBER = Q.QNA_NUMBER AND NVL(R.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ), 0 ) AS REPLY_CNT , Q.SUBJECT , Q.CONTENT , Q.KEYWORDS , D.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS QNA_USER_DEPT_NAME , U.USER_NAME_LOC AS ADD_USER_NAME_LOC , Q.ADD_DATE , SUBSTR(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(Q.ADD_TIME),'000000'),6,'0'),1,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(Q.ADD_TIME),'000000'),6,'0'),3,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(Q.ADD_TIME),'000000'),6,'0'),5,2) AS ADD_TIME , SC.TEXT1 AS STATUS , U2.USER_NAME_LOC AS MANAGER , CASE WHEN Q.STATUS IN ('F','A','G','CC') THEN Q.CHANGE_DATE ELSE '' END AS GW_CONFIRM_DATE FROM SQNAQ Q LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT U ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = U.HOUSE_CODE AND Q.ADD_USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT U2 ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = U2.HOUSE_CODE AND Q.MANAGER = U2.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT D ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = D.HOUSE_CODE AND U.DEPT = D.DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SCODE SC ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = SC.HOUSE_CODE AND SC.TYPE = 'QA001' AND SC.CODE = Q.STATUS AND SC.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER IN ($INS{SELECTED_QNA_NUMBERS}) ORDER BY Q.QNA_NUMBER DESC

SELECT R.QNA_NUMBER , R.QNA_SEQ , R.CONTENT , D.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS QNA_USER_DEPT_NAME , U.USER_NAME_LOC AS ADD_USER_NAME_LOC , R.ADD_DATE , SUBSTR(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(R.ADD_TIME),'000000'),6,'0'),1,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(R.ADD_TIME),'000000'),6,'0'),3,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(R.ADD_TIME),'000000'),6,'0'),5,2) AS ADD_TIME FROM SQNAR R LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT U ON R.HOUSE_CODE = U.HOUSE_CODE AND R.ADD_USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT D ON R.HOUSE_CODE = D.HOUSE_CODE AND U.DEPT = D.DEPT WHERE R.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND R.QNA_NUMBER IN ($INS{SELECTED_QNA_NUMBERS}) ORDER BY R.QNA_NUMBER DESC, QNA_SEQ ASC

SELECT Q.QNA_NUMBER , Q.SUBJECT , Q.STATUS , Q.CHECK_FLAG , Q.ADD_USER_ID , Q.ATTACH_NO , Q.MANAGER FROM SQNAQ Q WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND NVL(Q.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.QNA_NUMBER , R.QNA_SEQ , R.ATTACH_NO , R.ADD_DATE , R.ADD_TIME FROM SQNAR R WHERE R.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND R.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND NVL(R.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(TRIM(R.ATTACH_NO), '0') <> '0' ORDER BY R.ADD_DATE DESC, R.ADD_TIME DESC, TO_NUMBER(R.QNA_SEQ) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , DOC_NO , DOC_SEQ , TYPE , DES_FILE_NAME , SRC_FILE_NAME , FILE_SIZE , DEL_FLAG , ROOT_PATH FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = ${ATTACH_NO} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ)
